title: docs(pm-dispatch): record the dequeue actor, the footer surface axis and objectui's label stripper
body:
Fixes #19343, fixes #19179, fixes #19404

Clause-②: no

Four platform-fact rows were dispatched for one file,
`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`. Each row's premise was
re-read on the base before writing. **Two of the four were already covered on the base**
and are reported as falsified rather than restated; the other two are recorded, plus two
in-place corrections. The ceiling was not raised.

## Premise reading per row (measured on `origin/main`, before any edit)

| card | premise | evidence on the base |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #19343 | **partly valid** | the headline fact was already there: `:16` states the SUCCESS sequence carries `removed_from_merge_queue`, `:17` gives the disambiguator (no `merged` after it, PR still open). The branch-listing refinement was also already there: `:63` (`只在存在时有意义`) plus `:64` and `:44`. **Uncovered delta: the actor** — `grep github-merge-queue` returned 0. That delta is what this PR adds. |
| #19390 | **valid** (footer half) | `:345` covers `PATCH /pulls` on a PR; `:414` covers the issues route on a real issue. The measured cell — the issues route aimed at a **pull request** — was absent. |
| #19404 | **FALSIFIED** | both halves already on the base. Channel: `:125` `job 日志只有 MCP 取得回,REST 侧转 blob 存储`, with the general form at `:122` and the action form at `:123`. Self-bound Routine: `:457` `自绑唤醒的是已存在的会话、工具已加载`. |
| #19179 | **valid** | `grep -E 'labeler|sync-labels'` returned 0. The general read-back discipline exists at `:244`/`:245`, but the named objectui mechanism did not. |

## What changed (6 insertions, 5 deletions, one file)

Recorded:

- **`:348` (new)** — the footer append follows the SURFACE, not the route: an issues-route
  body PATCH aimed at a pull request takes the same +58 bare-footer append, and leaves the
  draft bit alone. `:414` is scoped to a real issue in the same edit, so the pair now states
  which axis it varies on.
- **`:245` (new)** — objectui's labeler runs with `sync-labels: true`, so the PR label set is
  recomputed wholesale from the diff's paths and a hand-applied label dies on the next push;
  re-applying loses the same race again, which is why the row says not to.

Corrected in place (0 net lines):

- **`:17`** — both queue exits carry `github-merge-queue[bot]`, so the actor discriminates
  nothing. This is the one piece of #19343 the file lacked.
- **`:304`/`:305`** — the old pair read `get_job_logs 无论 tail_lines ... ⇒ 两者都答不了到底挂在哪`,
  which is exactly the misreading #19404 was filed about. Scoped to `tail_lines` and corrected:
  with `return_content` the whole log came back. The REST-leg clause retired into `:125`, which
  already carries it.

## Line budget — the ceiling is not raised

- before **468** / ceiling **469**; after **469** / ceiling **469**. The ratchet row is untouched.
- Paid for by retiring one **provable duplicate**: old `:64` `⛔ 它的缺席不是任何方向的读数。`
  Its fact is stated twice more in the same file — `:63` `gh-readonly-queue/* 只在存在时有意义`
  (only meaningful when present, i.e. absence says nothing) and `:44`
  `ref 缺席只作旁证,⛔ 永不承载结论`.
- Every line is within the file's own 120-byte cap, enforced by
  `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (table rows are structurally exempt and this file's
  table-row pin is 0, so the rows are bullets). Widest line after the edit: 0 lines over 120 bytes.

## Gates — 20 derived families, 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`
(no hand-written path list) and reconciled with `--ran`, re-run on the final head `3bfd45c32`
after merging `origin/main`:

- `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 20 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 20 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`
- `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: ...platform-readings.md is 469 lines (ceiling 469; headroom 0).`
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint :: exit 0` and `pnpm check:nul-bytes :: exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited **3 —
  PREREQUISITE NOT MET**, which its own text says measured nothing. Built its two declared
  prerequisites through the shared verify lock, re-ran, exit **0**. Recorded as measured, not
  as a failure.
- Control-character self-scan over the changed file: 0 hits.

`skip-changeset` is correct and measured, not assumed: of **70** non-private manifests (all 70
declare `files[]`), **0** have a package root containing the changed path; positive control
`packages/spec/package.json` is contained by exactly 1 published root, so the instrument fires.

## Scope notes (filed, not fixed here)

- **#19390 remains open deliberately** — hence `Part of`, not a closing keyword. Its footer half is
  recorded here, but the card also carries a second measured reading that is still absent from the
  file (`grep merge_commit_sha` ⇒ 0, lit control `grep -c auto_merge` ⇒ 3): a queued open PR's
  `merge_commit_sha` names an anticipated commit that is not on main and may never be. Closing the
  card would hide that half from every open-only filter, which `:445` warns about. The seat decides.
- **#19404 remains open** — its premise is falsified above, and per the dispatch a card whose row is
  already covered is not closed by the dev. The `:304`/`:305` correction it motivated is included
  anyway, because the old wording actively produced the error the card describes.
- The file states both `红窗里 draft 翻转 ... 照常走 ccr REST,⛔ 不为它们守候` (`:145`/`:146`) and
  `⛔ 满余额不放行 undraft:同分钟满额而 ccr 路 429` (`:163`, with `:49`/`:50`). A seat could act
  wrongly on either. Noted, not touched — resolving it needs a measurement this card did not take.
- Two further duplicate pairs were found but **not** retired, because retiring either would orphan a
  neighbouring line that refines it: `:253`/`:318` (the MCP read path swallowing angle-bracket
  fragments inside inline code spans) and `:260`/`:322` (counting empty inline code spans as the
  discriminator). Left for a seat that can judge the collateral.

## Deviations, declared

- The dispatch asked each row to carry **the source card number**. It cannot:
  `scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` scans every `.md` under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`
  including `references/`, reds on `/#[0-9]{3,}/`, and the file carries 0 such tokens today.
  Card numbers were omitted; measurement dates were kept where they are load-bearing, matching
  the file's existing style. The gate passes.
- The dispatch's first line named all four cards. Two were dropped from it on the evidence above.
- Commit trailers use the repository's **model-free** pair, as AGENTS.md requires and the pre-push
  hook enforces.

Tier S governed surface (`.claude/**`): opened as a draft and left that way — not marked ready,
auto-merge not armed. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` reading is in the report comment on #19343.
